correctness.rationale: The graph is reconstructed over F13 from the six quadratic residues, and all 8192 subsets are enumerated. Complete face counts of 598 (N) and 7592 (D) are independently cross-checked by exact mod-two boundary reductions. Deterministic full-Hasse acyclic matchings consist of 286 and 3783 verified pairs and leave exactly one critical zero-cell plus 25 critical cells in dimensions two and eight, respectively. Topological sorting of all 2067 and 47528 matched Hasse incidences rigorously verifies acyclicity. Discrete Morse theory gives the claimed integral wedges, not merely field-homology equivalence. The checker itself is embedded and reproducible.

value.rationale: This is an exact classification of two canonical algebraically dual topological invariants of the canonical 13-vertex six-regular Paley conference graph. The Lovasz neighborhood complex is a graph-coloring-topology object; the 25-dimensional second-homology rank and its integral homotopy type are not supplied by existing low-degree circulant theorems or graph parameters. Self-complementarity produces a motivated dual counterpart at dimension eight, computed independently. The classification is complete for its natural fixed object and avoids arbitrary parameter slicing, routine deductions and unsupported family claims.
